physicallyIsolatedActive.gate: Preferred configuration: enable H/I only after independent speaker wiring is metered isolated from A/B, firmware stores LR24 HP >2.5kHz, and -18dB attenuation is verified. Speaker connections must be independent.

eqAndMeasurements.inputEq: Start flat; use ISA correlated pink noise to measure each Tesla channel and merged A+C / B+E before setting summation level, polarity, delay and InputEQ. Correct source filtering, never assume original full-range.
eqAndMeasurements.virtualEq: Flat (0 dB), no boosts at commissioning; group EQ only after measuring.
eqAndMeasurements.outputEq: 0 dB / no preset boosts; measure with calibrated mic + RTA then cut peaks; tune polarity/time alignment at listening position.
eqAndMeasurements.gain: Start attenuated at least -12 dB; H/I -18 dB and muted until isolated and protective HP stored. Check system headroom and gain without clipping.
eqAndMeasurements.status: PROVISIONAL STARTING VALUES, NOT A MEASURED FINAL DSP FILE
eqAndMeasurements.signalSummation: Input EQ cannot restore full missing bands from one high/low Tesla source. Use ISA/AISA plus input phase/time tools to confirm useful complementary signals, align and avoid cancellation. If measured bands overlap, reduce summation gain for headroom. Do NOT use arbitrary 50/50 before verification.

safetyChecks: Archive existing DSP PC-Tool setup before rewiring. Disconnect/isolate 16V LV per Tesla procedure before harness work.
Continuity-test new connector pin-to-conductor-to-return for all seven +/- channels; verify Tesla X171/X175 pin numbers from OEM diagrams without trusting connector view orientation.
No speaker OUT must connect to another amplifier OUT or backfeed OEM source IN; inspect existing right dash bypass symptom.
Disconnect both separate H/I tweeter power outputs until physically verified isolated wiring and HP filters are active.
Confirm passive tweeter crossover exists in any shared A/B speaker branch; otherwise do not energize.
Measure each Pioneer driver's DCR/impedance and check separate +/− leads; do not bridge J/K.
In DSP PC-Tool enable VCP, route sources by function, run ISA then configure crossovers and save setup under a new slot.
Low-volume channel sweep A-G, then conditional H/I, then J/K; stop if unexpected speaker plays or DSP off still yields output.
Verify DIRECTOR SubRC affects BOTH physical J and K; this requires VCP routing virtual Subwoofer 1/2. Without VCP only physical K/L are manufacturer-tied to SubRC.
Never connect bare 3-ohm woofer and 4-ohm tweeter directly in parallel; this would go below the amplifier's 2-ohm minimum and overdrive the tweeter.
subwooferRemoteControl: CRITICAL: With VCP ON, remote SubRC follows virtual channels Subwoofer 1 (K) and Subwoofer 2 (L) to physical outputs J/K; with VCP OFF the manufacturer's manual states SubRC tied only to physical K/L, so physical J would not follow remote sub volume. Enable VCP and verify both J/K respond to DIRECTOR.
speakerLoadSafety: Manufacturer HELIX Ci7 W200FM-S3 is 3 ohm; Ci7 T20FM-SC is 4 ohm. Never connect bare woofer and tweeter directly in parallel to one output: nominal resultant is below the V TWELVE 2-ohm minimum and tweeter is unprotected. A passive crossover must be verified and total load checked before shared operation. Preferred installation is distinct A/B woofers and H/I tweeters.
